input_policy: Original image-pixel ROIs from three actual Torgsoft receipts; no artificial resize; split multi-line names identically for all recognition engines
execution_policy: sequential single-cell OCR, same input pieces in original order; default model parameters except task/language/path/required shape; one engine per model, no concurrent OCR jobs
score_policy: CER / exact by script-supported fields; no transliteration; provisional agent-verified transcription, owner not approved
model_policy: Six Cyrillic-capable OCR engines; English-only variants excluded
parameter_policy: Only required model selection, script/language, detector disabled, architecture-required shape and single-line Tesseract PSM; no tuning sweeps
